cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You like the blue campaign poster? I'll tell the volunteers they're happy with me in charge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The colour, yes. Could we work on the slogan together?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Of course. I'm glad everyone's accepted my collaborative leadership.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let's each write one and let the volunteers choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. My first act as campaign leader is to delegate the decision.

mechanism: A treats agreement to colour and collaborative slogan selection as completed acceptance of A leadership, professionally organising the supposed delegation.
confusable: D55 recruits coalition members; D71 claims leadership already accepted from small points of agreement.
comparison: Committee alternative absorbs adversarial budget scrutiny; poster alternative absorbs cooperative shared authorship and voting.
seedUse: Blue poster, slogan collaboration and volunteer vote derive from D71-b; S03 adds decision record and ballot consistency corrections.
